items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: I had a great drummer with me... his name was Danny Alvin... And we had a trio.

ctx.x: No it was jazz. If anybody wanted to get up to dance they wouldn’t prevent them Monk, but it was mostly listening at Jimmy Ryan’s. I went in there for two weeks and I stayed there for one year. And I had a great drummer with me if you don’t mind me mentioning his name — I don’t think he’s around today — he was from Chicago, his name was Danny Alvin. Great drummer, sensational. And I had Hank Duncan on piano. And we had a trio. And we went in there for two weeks and we stayed for one year with this trio. And you…
